tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[$X_G$ for $G=\Z _n$] ↗ cor:every-group-realized-as-pi1 1. ch1:1.29\group Fundamental Group

For $G=\langle a\mid a^n\rangle =\Z _n$, $X_G$ is $S^1$ with a 2-cell attached by $z\mapsto z^n$. For $n=2$ it is $\RP ^2$; for $n>2$ the $n$ local sheets meeting along the attaching circle prevent it from being a surface. \end{example}
